findings.label: DynamoDB subsegment is implicit
findings.detail: The handler wraps the model call in an explicit 'bedrock-invoke' X-Ray subsegment but relies on patch_all() to instrument the DynamoDB subsegment rather than an explicit named 'ddb-*' subsegment the plan sketched. patch_all() does instrument boto3/DynamoDB, so acceptance #28 is satisfied; an explicit named subsegment would be a clarity-only improvement.

findings.label: Guardrail PII action/entity renamed to deployable values
findings.detail: Design specified entity ACCOUNT_NUMBER with action MASK; implementation uses US_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER with ANONYMIZE because those are the valid enum values in aws-cdk-lib@2.160.0's CfnGuardrail. The required behavior (mask PII on the model channel) is preserved. Documented in verification-notes.md.

findings.label: ApplyGuardrail grant may be unused at runtime
findings.detail: bedrock:ApplyGuardrail is granted defensively on both the endpoint policy and the agent role, scoped to the guardrail ARN. The inline-guardrail wiring may not issue a separate ApplyGuardrail call, so the grant can be unused; it is least-privilege-scoped and documented in code.
